## What's Changed

- Adds server-backed watch-progress clearing for Tater Tube Player, allowing a
  partially watched movie or episode to be reset and removed from Continue
  Watching without marking it complete.
- Includes local NFO metadata with Continue Watching items so the modern
  playback-details card can show the synopsis, year, content rating, community
  score, runtime, and genres when those details are available.
- Fixes the 1950s through 1990s auto-channel labels so they correctly use
  `50S`, `60S`, `70S`, `80S`, and `90S` instead of `95S` through `99S`.
- Rebuilds the Tube TV guide cache so the corrected decade channels select
  their existing unique Tater-themed logos instead of generic Movies or TV
  artwork.
- Adds regression coverage for metadata-rich Continue Watching entries,
  clearing saved progress, decade labels, and embedded channel-logo matching.

## Compatibility

The play-state clear endpoint is additive and used only by the modern Tater
Tube Player. Existing retro players keep their established playback and
progress behavior. They may also show the corrected decade channel names and
Tater logo overlays after the guide rebuilds.

## Upgrade

Use your container manager's **Update/Recreate** action to pull
`ghcr.io/tatertotterson/tater-tube-server:latest` and recreate the existing
container with its current settings.

No configuration or database migration is required.
